title: The Railway Station Goodbye
subtitle: When Missing Someone Taught Me Her Value
quote: Sometimes, you don't realize how important someone has become until it's time to say goodbye.
endQuote: People often say that goodbyes reveal the value of relationships. Standing on that railway platform, watching Grace's train disappear into the distance, I finally understood what they meant. She wasn't just someone I talked to anymore. She had quietly become someone I missed the moment she wasn't around.

content.text: By the second week of January, Grace and I had become much closer than we had ever imagined.
Our conversations had become a part of our everyday lives.
A day without talking to her felt incomplete.
Whether it was about classes, assignments, funny incidents, or completely random topics, we always found something to talk about.
She was no longer just a junior.
She had become someone whose presence made even an ordinary day feel special.
Grace had planned to visit her hometown for a few days.
When she told me she was leaving, I simply smiled and said,
I didn't want her to leave.
Not because she was going away forever.
But because I had become so used to seeing her every day.
A few hours later, she sent me a message.

content.speaker: Grace
content.text: Hari... I'm leaving for the railway station.
I looked at the message for a few seconds.
A few moments later, I was on my way.
But my mind was focused on only one destination.
When I reached there, I saw her standing with her luggage.
She was talking to her friends.
The moment she noticed me, a smile appeared on her face.

content.speaker: Hari
content.text: Some promises are meant to be kept.
For the next few minutes, we simply stood there talking.
We spoke about the upcoming classes.
People hurried from one platform to another.
For me... the entire station felt silent.
All I could hear was her voice.
The smile on my face slowly disappeared.
I didn't want that conversation to end.
Grace picked up her bag and looked at me.
She looked at me for a second.

content.speaker: Grace
content.text: Don't forget to reply to my messages.
That smile... It stayed with me long after the train left.
The train slowly began to move.
She stood near the door, waving one last time.
Then the train disappeared into the distance.
I don't know how long I remained there.
Something inside me felt strangely empty.
It was only a short trip.
She would return in a few days.
The campus already felt different without her.
That was the moment I realized something.
Grace had quietly become an important part of my life.
That night, after reaching home, she sent me a message.
I looked at the message and smiled.

content.speaker: Hari
content.text: Good. I was waiting for this message.
For a moment, I simply stared at the screen.
It was the feeling behind them.
That made me happier than I could explain.
The next few days felt unusually quiet.
Every place on campus reminded me of her.
The library where we discussed assignments.
Missing someone isn't about the distance between two places. It's about the space they leave behind in your heart.
Grace wasn't thousands of kilometers away.
She was only in her hometown.
But even that small distance was enough for me to understand how much she had become a part of my everyday life.
I wasn't waiting for classes to begin.
I wasn't waiting for another event.
I wasn't waiting for the weekend.
